title: Audiences Basics
objectives: Understand Core Audience targeting: location, age, gender, and interests
Read Meta's Audience Definition meter (narrow vs balanced vs broad)
Learn why modern Meta algorithms thrive on broader audiences

blocks.text: Targeting is choosing who gets to see your offer. Let's make sure your rupees reach the right eyeballs!
At the Ad Set level, you define your audience using Location, Demographics (Age/Gender), and Detailed Targeting (Interests and Behaviors).

blocks.title: The 4 Core Audience Levers
items: 1. Location: Country, state, city, or postal code radius (e.g., 5km from your salon)
2. Age Range: Match your real buyers (e.g., 25-45 for home buyers)
4. Detailed Targeting: Interests (Yoga, Startups, Fashion) or Broad

blocks.title: The Megaphone Analogy
blocks.text: Targeting 5,000 people is like shouting into a tiny room. You will run out of listeners in 2 days. Targeting a balanced pool of 500,000 gives Meta room to breathe and find buyers.
Meta's AI is smarter than ever. Often, broad targeting (leaving interests open) lets the algorithm find cheaper leads than stacking 15 interests.
Avoid hyper-narrow audiences (< 50,000). Your ad frequency will spike, and your CPM will double or triple!

quiz.q: What happens when your target audience size is too narrow (e.g. 15,000 people)?
options: CPM increases significantly and frequency fatigues quickly
Meta shows your ad for free
quiz.hint: What happens when you shout at the same tiny group of people repeatedly?
quiz.explain: A tiny audience leads to fast audience fatigue, high frequency, and expensive auction CPM penalties.

quiz.q: A bridal makeup artist in Hyderabad should target which audience demographic?
quiz.hint: Who realistically books bridal makeup in Hyderabad?
quiz.explain: Local service businesses should tightly target the relevant gender, age group, and local city radius.

quiz.q: What is 'Broad Targeting' in modern Meta advertising?
options: Showing ads to people on other continents
Targeting based on location and age without restricting interests, letting Meta AI find the best buyers
quiz.hint: Think of trusting Meta's algorithm to analyze who engages with your creative.
quiz.explain: Broad targeting sets location and demographic bounds, allowing Meta's creative-driven AI to find active buyers.

quiz.q: True or False: Stacking 20 different interests together is always better than testing broad audiences.
quiz.hint: Modern Meta ads rely heavily on creative targeting.
quiz.explain: False! Over-constraining with 20 interests restricts Meta's auction efficiency and raises CPMs.

recap: Core targeting controls Location, Age, Gender, and Interests at the Ad Set level.
Avoid narrow audiences (< 50k). Healthy balanced audiences give Meta room to optimize.
